predictions.rationale: Central domain model for Order; directly implements order creation, status, and lifecycle logic.
API controller for order operations; handles order creation, status updates, and cancellation endpoints.
Handles the command to create an order at checkout; directly supports order creation feature.
Defines order status enumeration and logic; essential for tracking order progress and state changes.
Handles order cancellation command; directly supports the cancellation aspect of the feature.
Handles transition of order status to stock confirmed; supports order tracking through stock confirmation.
Handles transition of order status to paid; supports payment tracking in the order lifecycle.
Handles order shipment command; directly supports shipment tracking in the order process.
Repository for order persistence; supports storage and retrieval of order data throughout its lifecycle.
Provides query operations for orders; supports tracking and retrieval of order status and details.
